            (<span class="hl-type">String</span>) map.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;email&quot;</span>),
            (<span class="hl-type">String</span>) map.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;emailDomain&quot;</span>),
            (<span class="hl-type">Boolean</span>) map.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;isAnchorUser&quot;</span>),
